title: Matrix Bullet
description:
This is a cyber 2D bullet-plume dodging game in which players aim to clear the screen by continuously dodging bullets until the count of "999" runs out.
Aim to clear the game while making full use of the slow function that slows down the speed of bullets.
The count will decrease further if you dodge the bullets just in time. Aim for faster clearing.

MatrixBullet is open to live broadcasts and distribution.
You do not need to report your situation when you do so.
We would appreciate it if you could include your sales site in the summary section.
